title: MVM Announces New Acquisitions For Early 2027
content:
MVM has announced on its X/Twitter feed that it will release two titles in early 2027 as Collector's Editions: the film Fate/Grand Order Final Singularity - Grand Temple of Time: Solomon (pictured right) and Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Season 5.

The Fate/Grand Order Final Singularity - Grand Temple of Time: Solomon anime adapts the Fate/Grand Order smartphone game's "The Grand Temple of Time Solomon" story, which is the Final Singularity in the game's first part. Toshifumi Akai returned from the previous Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia anime to direct the new film at CloverWorks , and Kinoko Nasu is credited for the original script.

MVM will also release standard editions of the following four titles: Kizumonogatari: Koyomi Vamp (the compilation film version of the three Kizumonogatari films), Ragna Crimson , Lycoris Recoil and Engage Kiss .
author: ANN

title: Netflix India Lists Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime for Release on October 20
content:
Netflix is listing the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime for release in India on October 20.

The staff describe the series:

It presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge. When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

The casts include (Japanese/English):

• Momoka Terasawa/Valeria Rodriguez as Roman Carax

• Akari Kitō/Kimoy Lee as Talia Yang

• Kōki Uchiyama/Nazeeh Tarsha as D

• Kentarō Tone/Clancy Brown as Weak Kingsley

Kai Ikarashi (who was a storyboard artist, animation director, animator, and prop designer for the first series) is helming the new series in his directorial debut. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners producer and writer Bartosz Sztybor is again working on the series, and Ichigo Kanno (animation director and key animator on the first series) is the lead character designer. Masahiko Otsuka is returning as the scriptwriter.

The new anime's opening theme song is The Cure 's 1978 song "10:15 Saturday Night," and the ending theme song is Petite Meller 's "Watson." Rapper RICO NASTY wrote and performed "YOU CAN'T RUN FROM ME" for the anime, and it appeared in the second teaser trailer.

The new anime will debut on October 20 on Netflix . The first episode had a premiere screening at Anime Expo on July 3.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , the anime series by Studio Trigger based on CD PROJEKT RED 's Cyberpunk 2077 game, debuted on Netflix in September 2022. The game is itself based on Mike Pondsmith 's Cyberpunk tabletop RPG game series. Netflix streamed the anime in India.

Aniplex of America released the series on a complete Blu-ray Disc set in North America in October 2025. Anime Limited and Plaion Pictures released the series on home video in Europe, and Sugoi Co released the series on home video in Australia and New Zealand.

A prequel manga titled Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness from artist Asano ( BNA: Brand New Animal manga) and writer Bartosz Sztybor ( CD PROJEKT RED ) launched on the Comic Alive+ website in December 2024, and is getting a release in seven languages aside from Japanese. Dark Horse is releasing the series in English in print.
author: ANN

title: Ghibli's Arrietty Opens in UK and Ireland IMAX cinemas from Wednesday
content:
GKIDS will release Studio Ghibli 's 2010 film Arrietty , directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi , on Wednesday October 14 and 15 in IMAX cinemas in the UK and Ireland, followed by a wider cinema release from Friday October 16. Screening dates and venue details are listed at https://www.gkids.co.uk/tickets/ .

The film will be screened in both dubbed and English-subtitled versions. The English dub will be the UK (not US) dub, which includes the first film role of Tom Holland , now Spider-Man in the MCU films. The dub cast also includes Saoirse Ronan , Olivia Colman , Geraldine McEwan and Mark Strong and is featured in the trailer below.

From the press release:

"In a secret world hidden beneath the floorboards, tiny people called Borrowers live out of sight of humans. But when brave Arrietty is out gathering supplies, she is discovered by Sho, a human boy, and they begin to form a friendship that blossoms into a heartwarming adventure.

" Arrietty is a gorgeous and adventure-filled adaptation of Mary Norton 's “The Borrowers,” one of the most beloved children's books of all time, directed by Academy Award®-nominee Hiromasa Yonebayashi based on a screenplay by Hayao Miyazaki , who also worked on project planning for the film, and Keiko Niwa ."

title: Muse Asia Licenses Kindergarten Wars Anime
content:
Muse Asia announced last Friday that it has licensed the television anime of Yū Chiba 's Kindergarten WARS ( Yōchien Wars ) manga. The anime will debut in Japan in spring 2027.

The anime stars:

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Rita

• Kentarō Kumagai as Doug

• Hitomi Ohwada as Hana

• Satoshi Hino as Luke

• Mariya Ise as Silvia

• Romi Park as Erina

• Tetsu Inada as Gordon

• Mirei Kumagai as Mac

• Sumire Morohoshi as Una

Shinsuke Gomi (episode director for Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba , Secrets of the Silent Witch ) is directing the anime at Sunrise and Felix Film , and Junko Yamanaka ( Kamisama Kiss , Servamp ) is designing the characters.

Shueisha 's MANGA Plus website publishes the Kindergarten WARS manga digitally. Yen Press is publishing the manga in print and it describes the story:

Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she's head-over-heels for good-looking men!

Chiba launched the manga on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app and website in September 2022. Shueisha published the manga's 18th compiled book volume on August 4. The manga entered its final arc in March 2025, and has over 2 million copies in circulation.

Chiba launched the Yōchien Wars -LUKE- ( Kindergarten WARS -LUKE- ) spinoff manga in November 2024. The spinoff manga is a 180-page story about the character Luke.

title: Zero Escape Writer Kōtarō Uchikoshi Announces Crash Keys Company With Cryptic Website, 'Canceled' Game
content:
Uchikoshi inquired on work requests and investment proposals for his company in his message. According to Crash Keys' website, his company is headquartered in Shibuya in Tokyo, in the same building as Izanagi Games, which has published the World's End Club game that Uchikoshi had worked on. In addition to CEO and director Uchikoshi, Crash Keys members include Akira Mine ( The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy, Danganronpa 2×2 ) and scriptwriter Muri Sasaki ( Seifuku no Ojisama, Zero Escape, AI: The Somnium Files ). Curiously, after a long gap of no text, the members section on Crash Keys' website lists two more encrypted biographies for "HLPUL UFHLK" and "CESTN RTKSH." While Uchikoshi has given no context to this message, cyphers based on the Zero Escape series suggest that two additional members are actual characters from that series.

Finally, the phrases "RHIZOME-9" and "MEMENTO MORI, IF THE NIN"e"TH LION ATE THE SUN" are written on the bottom right of the website. The latter phrase appears in the former's location in Uchikoshi's Virtue's Last Reward game in his Zero Escape series.

Uchikoshi is perhaps best known as the writer for the Zero Escape game series ( Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors , Virtue's Last Reward , Zero Time Dilemma ). He was also a writer for KID's Memories Off game series, which inspired five original video anime ( OVA ). He is known for being the planner and writer for the Infinity series of visual novels ( Never 7 , Ever 17 , Remember 11 , 12Riven ). Uchikoshi and Yūsuke Kozaki worked together on Spike Chunsoft 's AI: The Somnium Files game and its sequels, the most recent being the No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: The Somnium Files game . Uchikoshi worked with Kazutaka Kodaka ( Danganronpa ) on the adventure strategy game The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- . Uchikoshi is part of the Too Kyo Games company founded by Danganronpa 's Kodaka.

Uchikoshi also wrote the scripts for the Punch Line anime, and wrote the original concept for The Girl in Twilight anime.

title: Spider-Man, Venom, Iron Man & More Just Got the Ultimate Manga Makeover
content:
Spider-Man, Venom, Iron Man and more Marvel Comics icons have made their way to the world of manga with a cool new wave of releases as part of a huge new partnership. Marvel and manga have made for a great team in the past as fans had previously seen Marvel working together with Shueisha on all sorts of surprising titles. But following the end of their partnership earlier this year , Kadokawa has now teamed up with Marvel on a whole new wave of manga series fans need to keep an eye out for.

Marvel and Kadokawa officially announced their new partnership earlier this Summer with the intent of releasing new titles for some of Marvel’s most recognizeable heroes and villains. Now these titles have made their official release in Japan with the launch of each of their first chapters ( which you can find here ), and that means fans have now gotten the first respective looks at what kind of makeovers each of these Marvel icons will have going forward. You can check out an example of Venom’s big manga makeover below.

Marvel and Kadokawa Launch New Manga for Spider-Man & More

As part of this new initiative for Marvel and Kadokawa, there are currently five new titles released in Japan with Kadokawa’s KadoComi website. These include Venom: Lethal Protector The Manga , illustrated by Peperon, which sees Eddie Brock being overtaken by the symbiote and heading out on a whole new path of revenge. There’s Spider-Man: Shibuya Cross Line , illustrated by tokitokoro, which includes a brand new Spider-Man (who also teams up with a new version of Daredevil) who’s bit by a spider in Japan and investigates a serial murder in Tokyo. This seems to be a dramatic departure from the original series .

There’s also Spider-Gwen: Her Big Debut The Manga , illustrated by Ryusei Yamada, which seems more in line with the original as a young Gwen is bitten by a spider and needs to navigate her high school life while dealing with her father. There’s a new Deadpool manga too titled Deadpool: Millionaire With a Mouth The Manga from Housuke Momoi that sees Deadpool becoming so popular as part of the Avengers that his merch sales have made him a millionaire. Forming his own team, he takes on missions around the world.

What’s Next for Marvel and Kadokawa’s Team Up?

Then there’s Iron Man: I Am Iron Man The Manga from TERU, which seems to be the most traditional take out of all of these manga endeavors as it follows the MCU pattern Tony Stark on his path of becoming the titular hero after an incident in Afghanistan. Unfortunately these manga titles have yet to confirm any English language release plans as of the time of this writing, but it likely won’t be too long before fans outside of Japan will get the full experience with each of these titles.

We’ve seen Marvel have a lot of success with the Shueisha released manga titles in the past, and they included some wild ideas towards the end of that deal like an official crossover with Ultraman . There’s a hope that this team up will lead to the same success when it’s all said and done, but it’s starting out on a great foot with five titles to kick it all off. What are you hoping to see from this new generation of Marvel manga with Kadokawa? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Tezuka: God of Manga Documentary Film Launches Kickstarter Campaign
content:
The upcoming feature-length documentary on Osamu Tezuka titled Tezuka: God of Manga launched its Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign on Wednesday. The project streamed a trailer:

As of press time, the project has raised US$10,726 of its US$49,999 goal. The campaign ends on November 13.

Backer rewards include an Astro Boy T-shirt, a Blu-ray Disc or DVD of the film, a Black Jack giclée print by by manga artist Yūko Shimizu , a set of lithograph prints, a Tezuka color manga cover, and a Supporting Producer credit.

The film is scheduled to complete in 2028, the 100-year anniversary of Tezuka's birth. The backer rewards and film on Blu-ray Disc and DVD are slated for distribution in July 2028.

Director Jason Andrew Cohn and the Bread & Butter Films production team comprising Camille Servan-Schreiber, Jinko Gotoh, Glen S. Fukushima, and Roland Kelts are producing the documentary.

The documentary will feature interviews with manga and anime creators such as Katsuhiro Ōtomo ( Akira ), Riyoko Ikeda ( The Rose of Versailles ), Naoki Urasawa ( Monster, Pluto ), Gō Nagai ( Devilman ), Yoshiyuki Tomino ( Gundam ), MADHOUSE co-founder and anime producer Masao Maruyama ( Tokyo Godfathers ), anime director Rintarō ( Metropolis ), fantasy author Ada Palmer ( Too Like the Lightning ), Samuel Sattin ( Unico Awakening ), and Jorge R. Gutiérrez ( The Book of Life ). The documentary will also feature interviews with leading manga scholars such as Fred Schodt ( Manga! Manga! ) and Helen McCarthy ( The Manga Bible ).

If the crowdfunding campaign succeeds, the producers will schedule interviews with artists Paul Pope ( THB ) and Ronald Wimberly ( Prince of Cats ).

Tezuka was born in 1928 and he died in 1989. Arguably best known as the creator of Astro Boy , he has been called the “Godfather of Anime and Manga” due to his prolific output, pioneering techniques, and pervasive reimagining of genres. Although he is often referred to as the " Walt Disney of Japan," Helen McCarthy , author of The Art of Osamu Tezuka : God of Manga , wrote Tezuka "was more like Walt Disney , Stan Lee , Jack Kirby , Tim Burton, Arthur C. Clarke, and Carl Sagan all rolled into one incredibly prolific creator.” According to Tezukainenglish.com, "Over the course of his 40-year career, Tezuka created more than 700 volumes of manga, encompassing an estimated 150,000 pages of drawings. He also produced another 200,000 pages of storyboards and scripts for nearly 500 episodes of a variety of popular animated T.V. series and numerous award-winning short and feature-length animated films."
author: ANN

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Artist Returns With Special Tribute to Fall’s Darkest Romance
content:
The artist behind Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has returned amid the manga’s hiatus with a special new tribute to help celebrate the debut of Firefly Wedding’ s big anime. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway as fans are now seeing a whole new wave of anime making their respective debuts, and that includes a dark new romance series that’s already started to build a lot of buzz. That’s going even further with a special tribute from Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End’ s artist to help boost that even more.

The anime adaptation for Oreco Tachibana’s Firefly Wedding has officially made its debut as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and it’s already looking like it’s going to be the next Shogakukan anime hit. As part of the same publishing company, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End artist Tsukasa Abe has shared a special tribute artwork to help celebrate the new anime’s premiere and it’s a cool way to get introduced to Firefly Wedding ‘s main duo. You can check it out below.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Artist Shares New Firefly Wedding Tribute

Firefly Wedding has already been a popular manga series since its original debut in 2023 , and wrapped its run earlier this Summer. This made the new anime the first new release for the franchise in the time since, so it’s about to reach a whole new level of recognition with an adaptation that has a clear runway towards its eventual finale. The series introduces a young woman dying of a disease who makes a last ditch effort to marry an assassin in order to redeem herself in her family’s eyes before her eventual death. Which is a dark start to this central romance.

Takahiro Kamei directed the new series for david production ( the studio behind the JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure and Fire Force f ranchises ) with Yukiko Aikei designing the characters, Yuko Kakihara providing the scripts, and NOGRID composing the music. The central voice cast for the anime include the likes of Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya, Koki Uchiyama as Shinpei Goto, Kent Ito as Kotaro Ogawa, and Kenjiro Tsuda as Mitsueda. The opening theme for its is titled “Period” as performed by iri, and you can check it out in action with the creditless sequence in the video below.

How to Watch Firefly Wedding

If you wanted to check out Firefly Wedding as it airs its new episodes through the Fall, you can now find it streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll. There’s only one episode available at this time, but there will be an English dub release for it at a later date (which has yet to be confirmed by Crunchyroll). This new anime won’t be the only new release for the franchise on the horizon either as it’s getting ready for a multi-platform launch with another big adaptation now in the works.

Shortly after the debut of the anime’s premiere episode, Firefly Wedding also announced that a new live-action series was in development . Currently scheduled for a release sometime next year in Japan, there have yet to be any international release details revealed for it. title: Kadokawa Apologizes After Using Character Design Reference Without Permission for Pitch-Black Infatuation Manga
content:
The editorial department of Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine apologized last week for unauthorized use of Ieri Komen's character designs for some characters in Kei Natsumi 's manga adaptation of Rokakoen 's Pitch-Black Infatuation ( Shikkoku no Bojō ) novel. The editorial department stated that, normally, permissions are acquired before the serialization of the manga even begins. However, this time, the character designs were used without permission. The Young Ace editorial department took full responsibility for the mistake, with neither the original creator Rokakoen nor the manga creator Kei Natsumi bearing any responsibility. The department also apologized to Ieri Komen.

The Young Ace editorial department provided the timeline to explain how it made the mistake. Kei Natsumi 's pre-production on the Pitch-Black Infatuation manga begin in August 2025. The Young Ace editorial department communicated with the Kadokawa Horror Bunko editorial department (which publishes both of Rokakoen 's original Festival of Heresies and Pitch-Black Infatuation novels), saying that it would like permission to use Ieri Komen's character designs from their manga adaptation of Festival of Heresies . It specifically wanted to use the characters Rumi Sasaki and Yukiyoshi Aoyama, who appear in both stories ( Pitch-Black Infatuation is set in the same world as Festival of Heresies ). The Young Ace editorial department said that it then received a reply from the Kadokawa Horror Bunko editorial department, with the latter saying that "It's probably also fine to use original character designs." The Young Ace editorial department then spoke with Kei Natsumi , moving forward with using Ieri Komen's character designs as reference, with the reply from Kadokawa Horror Bunko remaining vague, and still without permission from Ieri Komen.

After Kadokawa published the first compiled book volume of the Pitch-Black Infatuation manga, Ieri Komen contacted the Young Ace editorial department and determined that aside from the two earlier mentioned character designs, the Pitch-Black Infatuation manga had also used character designs for two other characters (Ishigami and Emi Shimamoto), as well as a background location.

Rokakoen published the Festival of Heresies ( Itan no Shukusai ) novel in May 2021, and the Pitch-Black Infatuation novel in February 2022, both under Kadokawa Horror Bunko. Yen Press published both novels in English in November 2024 and August 2025, respectively.

Komen launched the manga adaptation of Festival of Heresies in Kadokawa 's Comic Walker website in July 2023, and ended it with the second volume in November 2025.

Natsumi launched the manga adaptation of Pitch-Black Infatuation in Young Ace on March 4. Kadokawa released the manga's first volume on August 4.

title: Shueisha's Manga Million Adds Hiromasa Okujima's Together with Serial-san Manga
content:
The service describes the manga:

While a sensational serial murder case grips the public, the notorious killer himself shows up at the doorstep of Chihiro Yoshida, a college student who lives a life of absolute freedom and debauchery. To save his own skin, Yoshida makes a bizarre proposal: "Why don't you assume my identity and live here?" Can Yoshida really pull off this "impersonation cohabitation" with a serial killer (and maybe even have fun doing it)? The master artist renowned for drawing the ultimate handsome men, Hiromasa Okujima , brings you a twisted, chaotic comedy about a high-stakes charade where getting found out is absolutely not an option!

The manga debuted in Shueisha 's Grand Jump Mucha magazine on February 25.

Okujima launched the Baban Baban Ban Vampire manga in Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine in October 2021. Akita Shoten published the manga's 14th compiled book volume on August 6. The series inspired an anime that streamed on Netflix in January 2025, along with a live-action film that opened in July 2025.

Viz Media 's SuBLime imprint for boys-love manga licensed SHOOWA and Okujima's Bad Boys, Happy Home ( Dōsei Yankee Akamatsu Seven ) manga, and released the first volume physically and digitally in July 2021. The pair launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Kachi Comi magazine in April 2018.

Okujima's Katei Kyōshi no Kishi Knight Desu. (I Am the Home Tutor Kishi Knight.) manga inspired a live-action series adaptation that premiered on January 5. Okujima serialized the manga in Akita Shoten 's Nicchan Gecchan magazine in 2019. Akita Shoten published one volume for the manga.
